slides.image_prompt: Dario Amodei in craftsman apron, profile view, holds glowing laptop chest-high displaying spinning 3D wireframe shapes. Claude logo glows warm orange neon on workshop wall. Electric blue deep purple, 35mm film, natural light, film grain.

slides.headline: ONE DESIGNER SHIPPED 3 FREE 3D WEBSITES USING CLAUDE CODE
slides.body: Designer MengTo used Claude Code with Opus 5 to build 3 three-dimensional animated landing pages, then released the full source code free. These sites cost thousands when an agency builds them by hand.

slides.headline: 1) USE MOBBIN MCP FOR REAL DESIGN REFERENCES
slides.body: "I want this landing page to feel like this design [paste Mobbin screenshot]. Use the same spacing, color palette, and section layout. Build it in Three.js with a rotating hero animation."

slides.headline: 2) USE COLLECTUI TO COPY REAL UI COMPONENTS
slides.body: "Here is a UI component I want on my site [paste CollectUI screenshot]. Recreate it as a Three.js section on my landing page. Match the proportions and font size exactly."

slides.headline: 3) CLONE KAGE, A FREE 3D SITE WITH FULL SOURCE CODE
slides.body: Kage is a free open-source Three.js template. "I cloned the Kage template. Change the rotating hero shape to a cube, swap colors to [brand color], rewrite the headline: [your text]."

slides.headline: 4) BUILD ON TOWERS, ANOTHER FREE 3D TEMPLATE
slides.body: Towers is MengTo's second free Three.js template, runs at 1-2MB. "I cloned the Towers template. Remove the third section, change the background to cream, and add a contact form that collects name and email."

slides.headline: 5) START FROM SKETCHBOOK, THE THIRD FREE TEMPLATE
slides.body: Sketchbook is the third free Three.js template from MengTo. "Using the Sketchbook template as a base, rebuild the hero section to show [your product] with a particle animation background in [brand color]."

slides.headline: SAVE THIS FOR TONIGHT
slides.body: You will want these tools open when you try it. Save this post. Daily AI news and real skills, every day

caption:
Swipe for 5 free tools Claude Code uses to build 3D animated websites from scratch, no design skills needed 🏗️

Mobbin MCP for live design references inside Claude, CollectUI for real UI component screenshots, Kage with full open-source code, Towers at 1-2MB and mobile-ready, Sketchbook as the third free starting point, plus the exact prompts MengTo used to build all three sites with Opus 5.

These sites cost thousands when an agency builds them by hand. With Claude Code and Opus 5, MengTo built three of them and released everything free. Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this could do for yours.

Sources: MengTo
